The IRGC described the vessels as “non-compliant” and said they were operating under US military aerial escort, with one tanker hit off the southern coast and two others in the eastern part of the strait. Iranian officials have characterised the blockade as an act of aggression, while Tehran is signalling both a willingness to negotiate, conditional on the US meeting its demands, including lifting the blockade and sanctions and releasing frozen assets, and readiness to respond to any further attacks.
